reasoning: Base ratings: the Pelicans are -2.1 and the Pistons +5.7 points per game against an average team; with home court that makes the Pistons 4.4 better here, total 231.
Rest, travel and availability move it 2.0 towards the Pelicans.
There are psychological storylines, but history says they are worth little here.
Bottom line: Pistons by 2.2, 57% to win; total 229 (80% range 205-253).
